admin.oauth_apps.cancel.description: Button that closes a dialog of the OAuth apps screen without changing anything.

admin.oauth_apps.hosts.empty.description: Heading of the empty list of denied hosts.

admin.oauth_apps.hosts.host.description: Label of the field of the host to deny.
